USE_CASES = [
    ("support-bot", "eu-west", False, "eu-west"),
    ("sales-assistant", "us-east", True, "eu-west"),
    ("health-records-qa", "eu-central", False, "us-east"),
    ("wiki-search", "ap-south", True, "ap-south"),
]

def plan(data_region, movable, model_region):
    if data_region == model_region:
        return "colocated_rag"
    if movable is True:
        return "replicate_index"
    return "retrieval_at_source"

patterns = set()
for name, data_region, movable, model_region in USE_CASES:
    pattern = plan(data_region, movable, model_region)
    patterns.add(pattern)
    print(f"{name}: {pattern}")
print(f"Patterns used: {len(patterns)}")
